caption: Everything is DARPA, everything is intelligence related. Everything. Intelligence groups are organized crime networks, working on behalf of the evils at be.
video_overlay_text_observed: Cover card: Palantir logo. Subsequent overlays cycle TIA / LifeLog / SMISC / Communicator program names against the spoken narration.
audio_content_summary: Argues that Palantir and Facebook are privatized DARPA surveillance programs: TIA (defunded 2003) reborn as Palantir via a CIA/In-Q-Tel seed; LifeLog (canceled Feb 4 2004) replaced by Facebook, launched the same day; SMISC as Cambridge Analytica; DARPA Communicator as Siri/Alexa — nine-plus programs privatized to evade oversight.
implied_frame: Frames a lineage in which nine-plus DARPA surveillance programs (TIA, LifeLog, SMISC, Communicator) were deliberately privatized into Big Tech — Palantir, Facebook, Cambridge Analytica, Siri/Alexa — to keep mass data collection running outside congressional oversight. The program-existence facts are real; the deliberate-continuation causation and several one-to-one program-to-company mappings are the disputed/unsupported layer.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~16.4 MB); delivery ~17.1 MB webm.
